verification_note: Certificate of canvass signed by the City Clerk and the district judge on October 18, 2013. Mayor: Berry 48,009 (68.10 percent), Dinelli 20,248 (28.72 percent), Heh 2,217, write-in 26. Berry won a majority, so no mayoral runoff occurred. The certificate text says the election was held on the 4th day of October 2013, but its title and the clerk index give October 8, 2013, which is the used date.

Certificate of canvass for the municipal run-off election, signed November 21, 2017. Mayor: Keller 60,249 (62.20 percent), Lewis 36,615 (37.80 percent). The October 3, 2017 first round (Keller 38,163; Lewis 22,241; no majority) is in the amended certificate of canvass at the second additional URL. The runoff PDF was read from an Internet Archive copy (captured 2024-07-11) of the city clerk file because the live city URL returns 404.
